scientific_integrity: A self-contained proof identifies the branch, asymptotic coefficient, and heterogeneity inequality. Numeric examples test coefficients but do not replace proof. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Local in closing-edge weight with fixed positive path weights; full-text comparisons with some Delorme--Poljak spectral-bound papers remain unavailable. A broad prior weighted-cycle formula could conceivably imply the expansion; this has not been ruled out by exhaustive literature access.
title: Sharp quadratic onset of Max-Cut SDP gaps on inhomogeneously weighted odd cycles
